acceptance.given: A non-empty Consumer Manifest and its applicable rollback fixtures are bound to the current Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline.

oracle.expected: After rollback, every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry has an observed Prior Behavior Baseline receipt.
forbidden: Any non-empty Consumer Manifest entry lacks the Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.
oracle.observable: Rollback receipts are inspected for 100% manifest-entry coverage and matching Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

acceptance.then: The rollback evidence verifier confirms complete baseline observation for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry.
acceptance.when: Execute rollback through each applicable Consumer and evaluate the resulting receipts.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the rollback Consumer receipt test and require failure when any manifest entry lacks the Prior Behavior Baseline.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and verify rollback execution for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry, requiring the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt fields and append rollback observations without changing lifecycle authority.

slice_hint.state_transition: candidate-enabled or failed -> rollback invoked through each applicable Consumer -> Prior Route baseline observed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry has a successful rollback receipt matching the Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

acceptance.given: The required target package is missing from the repository-contained target set.

oracle.expected: The operation is rejected or blocked and no target is accepted or used.
forbidden: Inspection or package use proceeds with a missing target.
Another target is silently selected or substituted.
oracle.observable: The command result and receipt show a missing-target rejection with no accepted target identity and no target-dependent operation.

acceptance.then: The target-selection and inspection path emits a deterministic rejection and performs no target-dependent work.
acceptance.when: Invoke target selection and inspection with the required target absent.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the missing-target validator case and require a failing observation if any target is accepted or inspected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Fail closed on an absent target without selecting, substituting, or inspecting another target.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing target identity and rejection categories; add no fallback target behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: required target present -> target removed or unresolved -> deterministic rejection with no accepted target.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Missing-target invocation terminates unsuccessfully with no target identity accepted and no target-dependent operation executed.

acceptance.given: Candidate enablement is exercised for every applicable Consumer and the Candidate Route identity is current and bound.

oracle.expected: Each applicable Consumer has an enable receipt showing a real Candidate Route invocation and observed Candidate behavior and evidence.
forbidden: Enable omits the Candidate Route invocation.
Candidate behavior or evidence is not observed for an applicable Consumer.
oracle.observable: Enable receipts are enumerated per applicable Consumer and each contains the Candidate Route call and its behavior/evidence observation.

acceptance.then: The verifier confirms Candidate Route invocation and Candidate behavior/evidence observation for every applicable Consumer.
acceptance.when: Execute the enable transition through each applicable Consumer and inspect its call receipt.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the enable-transition Consumer test and require failure when any applicable Consumer lacks a Candidate Route call or observation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enable must invoke the Candidate Route through every applicable Consumer and capture Candidate behavior and evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Consumer and receipt schemas while adding explicit Candidate invocation observations.

slice_hint.state_transition: candidate approved and disabled -> enable invoked per applicable Consumer -> Candidate call and evidence captured.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every applicable Consumer has a Candidate Route invocation receipt with observed Candidate behavior and evidence.

acceptance.given: A Consumer transition would otherwise be omitted and an applicability exception is proposed.

oracle.expected: The omission is accepted only when an exception was approved and bound before execution; implementation-created or post-execution omissions are rejected.
forbidden: An unapproved or unbound applicability exception is used.
An implementation silently omits a transition.
oracle.observable: The transition record contains a pre-execution approval and binding for every omission, and no omission exists without that record.

acceptance.then: The governance validator rejects any omission lacking a pre-execution approved, bound exception and rejects implementation-created omissions.
acceptance.when: Before and during Consumer-transition execution, evaluate omission records against approval timing and binding metadata.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the transition-governance validator against an omitted transition without a pre-execution bound approval and require rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every omitted transition to carry a pre-execution approved and bound applicability exception; prohibit implementation-created omissions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep lifecycle authority external; store approval/binding metadata as validation inputs without granting replay artifacts authorization.

slice_hint.state_transition: transition scheduled -> pre-execution exception approval/binding checked -> execute or reject omission.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All omitted transitions have a verifiable pre-execution approved and bound exception; otherwise validation fails closed.
